samples.reason: The flagged dual-side-sync skill and helper implement explicit developer source synchronization to a user-configured SSH peer, not credential acquisition or covert transfer. All 4640 regular file contents match canonical upstream. Clipboard monitoring and encryption fit the advertised application.
execution_evidence: .agents/skills/dual-side-sync/sync-to-win.sh dispatches only explicit commands; require_config rejects missing WIN_HOST/WIN_USER/WIN_REPO.
push derives files from git ls-files, runs rsync to WIN_USER@WIN_HOST:WIN_REPO, then removes only explicitly locally deleted tracked paths from that remote checkout.
reset performs git reset --hard and clean only in WIN_REPO; install-rsync downloads the disclosed rn7s2/rsync-win archive into the remote user profile and updates user PATH.
PowerShell -EncodedCommand uses an explicitly assembled local snippet encoded as UTF-16LE/Base64; SSH authentication uses developer configuration, not harvested credentials.

The SKILL.md Git-state protection description is stale: current push deliberately does not gate on HEAD or dirty state. This is a documented-purpose tooling defect, not evidence of malicious destruction.

Pinned Engine dependency was fetched for source review: clipboard bytes are encrypted by EncryptingClipboardEventWriter, outbound scope restricts recipients, and MemberSendGate honors send/content preferences.
samples.rule_decision: No firing hostile/suspicious traits; existing SSH, rsync, interpreter, encoding and clipboard capabilities accurately describe the bytes. No exclusions or classifier-score adjustments added.
samples.classifier_disagreement: Queued HOSTILE prior unsupported. Current local classifier is unflagged at every calibrated level both before and after (level -1).
samples.limitations: No developer configuration or deployment history; a static source review is not a security audit of all dependencies.

samples.identification: AutoIt loader carrying NetWire and an encrypted AveMaria/Warzone RAT
samples.reason: Reachable code records system-wide keystrokes to scrambled logs, recovers browser/email passwords, registers concealed login persistence and prepares cleanup. AutoIt drops/launches NetWire and decrypts a second RAT for process hollowing. These spy/stealer paths outweigh a generic remote-administration explanation.
execution_evidence: NetWire resource at outer offset 0x1056d4, length 135168; complete PE SHA256 3a8ffff8485c9ed35dae82574ea1a455ea2ead532251cebea19149d78dfd682c.

0x40b60e builds a 64-character alphabet and substitutes input through a six-position rotation. Only actual direct-call arguments were decoded; recovered values include Run, StubPath, NSS/SQLite APIs, Firefox queries and Chromium Login Data paths.

0x40e334/0x40e377 resolve RegisterRawInputDevices/GetRawInputData; handler dispatch reaches translated-key recording at 0x40db3b. ToAscii output reaches writer 0x40d74c, which calls the in-place scrambler 0x40d70c and WriteFile at 0x41cf14. Foreground context is appended by 0x40da18.

0x410efe resolves decoded PK11SDR_Decrypt; nearby SQLite selection targets moz_logins. Outlook decryption near 0x4124df and Chromium DPAPI recovery near 0x4151f1 copy decrypted values into credential records.

0x40c832 decodes SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run, then passes HKCU, REG_SZ and an executable-path buffer to 0x416ae2. Its RegCreateKeyExA and RegSetValueExA thunks are 0x41ce9c and 0x41ce64. Active Setup/StubPath is also decoded nearby.
0x40c38b creates and writes a temporary batch with ping/del/self-delete commands and invokes it via ComSpec; existing cleanup traits retained.

AutoIt top-level path concatenates AMSI1, UEVAGENTPOLICYGENERATOR2 and ACTXPRXY3 RT_DIALOG resources as ASCII hex, uses MD5 CryptCreateHash plus AES-256 CryptDeriveKey, then calls a reconstructed native loader.

The reconstructed 1474-byte loader resolves hashed APIs (CreateProcessW, Get/SetThreadContext, NtUnmapViewOfSection, WriteProcessMemory, VirtualAllocEx, ResumeThread). It calls CreateProcessW with CREATE_SUSPENDED at offset 0x2e7, operates on the same process/thread handles, maps PE sections and resumes the replaced image.

Decrypted second PE SHA256 9f50debb6a78fe7582dfbf7ca2366871d68878c5728aa01a943b926604c81d55, 100352 bytes. Its password-recovery, keyboard hook, hidden-account and RDP-setting code supports independent AveMaria/Warzone signatures.

Second-stage 0x40b81c binds fDenyTSConnections=0 and 0x40b896 binds EnableConcurrentSessions=1 to registry helper 0x40eb18, which calls RegSetValueExW. Other code handles ServiceDll and logon-list changes. Embedded UAC-bypass PE is identified separately, not claimed as runtime success.
AutoIt drops the NetWire RCDATA resource as Blasthost.exe and ShellExecutes it. It also removes its Zone.Identifier and copies/registers its own image for startup.
samples.rule_decision: Extend concealed Run registration, rotated-alphabet observation, browser credential recovery and Run persistence from raw excerpts to complete PE/DLL. Preserve original data scope and required recording/decoder context. PE browser recovery uses the parsed DPAPI import alternative.
samples.classifier_disagreement: None on original: flagged from level 25 with probability 0.99 both before and after.
samples.limitations: No execution or deployment history. Automatic scans extract the plaintext NetWire resource but do not unpack this AutoIt EA06 script/resource-decryption chain. The independently recovered Warzone stage has 10 unique hostile and 2 suspicious traits across its children, but those must not be counted as automatic findings on the original carrier. RDP configuration, encrypted hollowing and Zone.Identifier removal were traced but lack original-container static matchers because the decoded AutoIt facts/stage are unavailable to YAML. No family/API co-occurrence substitute was invented to conceal this engine extraction gap.

samples.identification: ProjectDiscovery Nuclei templates v10.4.5+incompatible Go-module ZIP
samples.reason: All 13695 member file contents match the canonical Go-module artifact, verified by Forager against sum.golang.org. This is an active security-probe corpus, without evidence of a substituted payload.
execution_evidence: CVE-2018-8033.yaml sends the supplied target an Apache OFBiz httpService request referencing the remote xxe-poc.dtd.

The DTD declares /etc/passwd, builds a nonexistent-path entity using its contents, and requests expansion; the template checks FileNotFoundException plus the root account pattern in the response. This is a real error-based XXE probe, not innocuous XML syntax.

The DTD also contains %disclose; despite declaring disclose as a general entity; actual template expansion behavior depends on parser settings. The accurate trait asserts the file target, not guaranteed exploitation.

assign_tasks.py uses its supplied GitHub token only in Authorization headers to api.github.com for issue assignment and review requests. update-kev.py retrieves CISA/VulnCheck catalogs and edits CVE template tags. .review-bot contains security-template review instructions and examples.
samples.rule_decision: Retain suspicious xxe-secret-file-target-host: crafted external entity targets /etc/passwd. Do not suppress accurate dual-use exploit evidence because the package is benign.
samples.classifier_disagreement: ML remains flagged only from false-positive calibration level 5000, probability 0.99909544, before and after. This is a package-level false positive; no misleading rule was added to change its score.
samples.limitations: Authorization for a particular use of the scanner is unknown; the distributed archive is legitimate security tooling.

counts_definition: Unique trait IDs at hostile/suspicious severity across original scan and all archive/embedded members; inherited copies deduplicated. Outer and member counts also recorded.

corrections.unsupported_claim: The matched byte-substitution loop alone does not select encoding versus decoding. Move the neutral transformation to codec; retain notable severity.
corrections.coverage: Same byte signature for raw data; parsed PE matches must lie within an executable section. No section-name gate. Both real raw and PE fixtures plus pointer/handoff/import/store/nonexecutable-section near misses pass.
corrections.consumers: All three exact YAML consumers updated: raw keylogger, browser recovery, Run persistence. No YAML references to the data, data/decode or data/decode/table ancestor selectors were found; historical review JSON remains historical.
